privacyPolicy.title: Privacy Policy
privacyPolicy.intro_text: Tinkerbell is committed to protecting your personal privacy. This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, share, and protect your personal information when you use our website.
privacyPolicy.usage_marketing: Send updates and promotional offers (with your consent)
privacyPolicy.usage_security: Protect against fraud and ensure platform security
privacyPolicy.sharing_text: We do not sell or rent your personal data to third parties. We may share information with:
privacyPolicy.sharing_payment: Payment service providers for transaction processing
privacyPolicy.sharing_legal: Legal authorities when required by law
privacyPolicy.cookies_text: We use cookies to improve your experience on our website. Cookies help us remember your preferences and analyze website traffic. You can set your browser to reject cookies, but this may limit some functionality.
privacyPolicy.security_text: We take appropriate technical and organizational measures to protect your personal data from unauthorized access, loss, or destruction. Payment transactions are conducted through secure channels with encryption.
privacyPolicy.rights_text: Under GDPR, you have the right to:
privacyPolicy.retention_text: We retain your personal data for as long as necessary to fulfill the purposes described in this policy, unless a longer retention period is required or permitted by law.
privacyPolicy.changes_text: We reserve the right to modify this Privacy Policy at any time. Changes will be posted on this page and take effect immediately upon publication.

termsConditions.title: Terms and Conditions
termsConditions.general_text: Welcome to Tinkerbell's website. By using our website, you accept these terms and conditions in full. If you disagree with any part of these terms, please do not use our website.
termsConditions.products_text: All products are subject to availability. We reserve the right to limit the quantity of any product we offer.
termsConditions.products_prices: Prices are subject to change without notice
termsConditions.products_vat: All prices are displayed in Euros (€) and include VAT
termsConditions.products_colors: Colors may vary slightly from actual appearance
termsConditions.orders_text: Each order constitutes an offer to purchase products from you. We reserve the right to accept or reject your order for any reason.
termsConditions.orders_confirmation: You will receive a confirmation email after completing your order
termsConditions.orders_acceptance: Email confirmation does not mean order acceptance
termsConditions.orders_shipping: We accept the order when we ship the products
termsConditions.orders_unavailable: In case of unavailability, we will contact you
termsConditions.payment_security: All payments are processed securely through Viva Wallet. We do not store credit card details on our servers.
termsConditions.shipping_cost: Shipping costs are calculated at checkout
termsConditions.shipping_disclaimer: We are not responsible for delays caused by the shipping company or force majeure.
termsConditions.warranty_text: All our products come with a quality warranty. If you receive a defective product:
termsConditions.warranty_contact: Contact us within 7 days of receipt
termsConditions.warranty_replacement: We will replace the product or refund your money
termsConditions.warranty_shipping: Return shipping costs are on us
termsConditions.liability_errors: Errors on the website or in product information
termsConditions.liability_limit: Our total liability is limited to the amount you paid for the specific order.
termsConditions.ip_text: All website content (texts, images, logos, designs) is protected by copyright and belongs to Tinkerbell. Reproduction without written permission is prohibited.
termsConditions.law_text: These terms are governed by Greek Law. The courts of Athens have jurisdiction over any disputes.
termsConditions.modifications_text: We reserve the right to modify these terms at any time. Changes take effect immediately upon publication on the website.

returnPolicy.title: Return Policy
returnPolicy.withdrawal_text: According to Greek and European Consumer Protection Law, you have the right to withdraw from your purchase within 14 calendar days from the date of receipt of the product, without needing to provide a reason.
returnPolicy.conditions_text: For a return to be accepted, products must:
returnPolicy.conditions_original: Be in their original condition, unused
returnPolicy.conditions_receipt: Be accompanied by the receipt or invoice
returnPolicy.conditions_unused: Not have been used, washed, or worn (except for trying on)
returnPolicy.conditions_damage: Not have suffered wear or damage
returnPolicy.exceptions_text: For hygiene reasons, the following products cannot be returned unless defective:
returnPolicy.exceptions_baptism: Baptism clothing that has been customized or embroidered
returnPolicy.process_contact: Contact us: Send email to info@tinkerbell.gr or call 2721 406303 within 14 days of receipt
returnPolicy.process_rma: Get authorization number: We will give you a unique return number (RMA)
returnPolicy.process_pack: Pack carefully: Pack the products in original packaging with all accessories
returnPolicy.process_ship: Shipping: Send the products to the address we will provide
returnPolicy.process_refund: Refund: After inspection, we will refund within 14 days
returnPolicy.costs_change_mind: Return without defect (simple change of mind): Return shipping costs are borne by the customer.
returnPolicy.costs_defect: Return due to defect or error: Return and new product shipping costs are on us.
returnPolicy.refund_method: In the same way you originally paid
returnPolicy.refund_time: Within 14 days of receiving the returned products
returnPolicy.refund_check: After checking the condition of the products
returnPolicy.refund_amount: For the full purchase amount (excluding shipping if applicable)
returnPolicy.refund_note: Note: If products are returned in unacceptable condition, we reserve the right to withhold part or all of the refund amount.
returnPolicy.exchange_text: If you wish to exchange size, color, or model:
returnPolicy.exchange_contact: Contact us as soon as possible
returnPolicy.exchange_availability: Exchange is subject to availability of the desired product
returnPolicy.exchange_cost: We do not charge extra fees for exchange (shipping only)
returnPolicy.exchange_process: The process is the same as for returns
returnPolicy.defects_text: If you receive a defective or incorrect product:
returnPolicy.defects_replace: We will replace the product free of charge
returnPolicy.defects_refund: Or we will fully refund your money
returnPolicy.delays_text: If your order is not delivered within the expected timeframe:
returnPolicy.delays_lost: If the package is lost, we will send a new one or refund
returnPolicy.refusal_text: If you refuse receipt of the order without reason, we reserve the right to charge shipping and handling costs before refunding the remaining amount.
returnPolicy.contact_address: Return Address: [Address to be provided upon contact]
returnPolicy.contact_note: Note: Do not send products without first contacting us and receiving an RMA number.
returnPolicy.tips_text: To maintain your right of return:
returnPolicy.tips_clean: Try clothes in a clean environment
returnPolicy.tips_labels: Do not remove labels until you are sure
returnPolicy.tips_products: Do not use perfumes or beauty products when trying on
